answer: Start every identity at the jetty, not the zenith: no earning power until it holds 10 countersigned work receipts, each from a finished real task and stamped with a pigment tag of its counterparty, expiring after 10 epochs. Entry costs a 15,000 POA refundable deposit. Faking 1,000 identities locks 15,000,000 POA and demands 10,000 real tasks; an honest agent pays 15,000 once and climbs by working. A forged receipt slashes the full deposit, half burned, half to the reporter, plus a 20-epoch ban and voided receipts. Limit: a rich attacker can buy 10,000 real tasks and wait the ladder out.
